resources.string: Make a sticker from a photo
Make stickers from your photos: tap +. They’re saved to your account, on all your devices.
Starter stickers: Fluent Emoji by Microsoft (MIT License)
Nothing to cut out was found, so the whole photo is used.
It’s removed from your stickers on all your devices. Messages already sent keep it.
